title: Guitars and Cadillacs
venue_description:
Guitars and Cadillacs - Kansas City's Premier Country Music Venue

Guitars and Cadillacs is KC's original live country music venue and dance hall located in Overland Park Kansas. For decades this iconic roadhouse has been the home of live country music with a rockin' atmosphere perfect for dancing. The venue is legendary in Kansas City music circles as a place where country music artists honed their craft before achieving national success.

Music and Events

The venue hosts live country music performances multiple nights per week with featured bands on Friday and Saturday evenings. The signature Country Jam Night happens on the first Sunday of every month where local musicians gather to jam with some of the best players in the Kansas City region. The jam features country blues and Southern rock music. Cover charge for Country Jam is just $5 for non-musicians. Thursday nights feature special events like Titos Thirsty Thursday with line dancing lessons. Friday nights highlight Fireball Friday with live country music and dance instruction.

Amenities and Atmosphere

The large dance floor is perfect for country line dancing with lessons offered multiple nights per week. The venue features a full bar with drink specials and quality comfort food. The unique cowboy and cowgirl hat shop adds to the distinctive Western atmosphere. Friendly professional bartenders provide quick service and creative mixed drinks at reasonable prices. Ample outdoor space for smokers and designated areas for pool and casual conversation. The energy and camaraderie among patrons makes this a must-visit destination for country music fans.

title: The Piano Room
venue_description:
The Piano Room - Kansas City's Traditional Piano Bar

Established in 1978 The Piano Room was originally called Inge's and has evolved into a beloved Kansas City institution. Located in the Waldo neighborhood at 332 W 75th Street the Piano Room is a traditional piano bar known for its intimate welcoming atmosphere and commitment to live music. The venue is proudly LGBTQ+ inclusive and functions as an everybody bar that welcomes all music lovers and performers.

Live Music and Entertainment

The Piano Room features nightly entertainment with different programming throughout the week. Wednesday nights are dedicated to open mic nights where anything goes - performers bring guitars poetry comedy and vocal performances. The piano keys are always ready for piano players and singers. Tuesday nights feature full bar karaoke experience with lyrics displayed throughout the bar. The venue maintains regular hours from 10:00 AM to 1:30 AM daily making it accessible for both evening and late-night music sessions.

Atmosphere and Community

This intimate space is frequented by customers who are always welcomed to the microphone creating a true community gathering spot. Singers and music lovers alike find this a unique Kansas City venue where musical traditions are celebrated. The welcoming staff and friendly patrons create an environment where performers feel comfortable sharing their art. The venue's decades-long history makes it a cultural landmark in the Kansas City music scene.

title: BrewTop Pub and Patio
venue_description:
BrewTop Pub and Patio - Sports Bar and Live Music Venue

The BrewTop Pub and Patio is a popular spacious hangout located in Corbin Park in Overland Park Kansas. This versatile venue serves as a sports bar live music venue and casual dining destination. With over 75 menu items and a kitchen open until 1:30 AM seven days a week BrewTop offers something for everyone.

Live Music Programming

BrewTop is known for hosting the areas best live bands performing rock country blues and pop covers. The venue schedules live music most nights of the week creating a vibrant entertainment atmosphere. The large stage and quality sound system showcase local and touring musicians. Music genres range from classic rock to contemporary pop with strong country and blues representation.

Amenities and Dining

The sizable easygoing venue features numerous large screen TVs making it ideal for watching major sporting events and games. An extensive beer selection with over 75 beers on tap along with craft cocktails caters to all tastes. The food menu includes pub favorites appetizers and seasonal specials with reasonable prices and portions. A large patio area provides outdoor seating and entertainment space. The friendly attentive staff and reasonable prices create a welcoming environment for all guests making it a go-to destination for live entertainment and dining.

title: Last Call Speakeasy
venue_description:
Last Call Speakeasy - Prohibition-Era Cocktail Lounge

Hidden behind an unmarked door Last Call Speakeasy is an upscale intimate venue that blends prohibition-era intrigue with modern cocktail craft. Located at 12687 Metcalf Avenue in Overland Park this speakeasy creates an exclusive sophisticated atmosphere perfect for special occasions celebrations and intimate gatherings.

Cocktails and Craft

Last Call is known for expertly crafted experimental cocktails created with molecular techniques including smoke vapor and infusions. Each drink arrives as a small elegant spectacle showcasing the bartender's artistry and innovation. The refined cocktail program features creative seasonal selections alongside classic cocktails. The low-lit warm ambiance provides the perfect backdrop for enjoying these meticulously crafted beverages.

Music and Events

The speakeasy hosts live music on Friday and Saturday nights featuring singer-songwriters and acoustic performers. The intimate setting creates an ideal environment for experiencing music in a close personal way. The venue specializes in private events corporate gatherings and celebrations with customizable experiences. A dedicated events team works to create seamless personalized experiences for all occasions.

Dining and Atmosphere

Refined tapas complement the cocktail menu with chef-driven bites aromatic small plates and playful flavor twists. The menu is carefully designed to pair with the bar's unique creations. The intimate secretive and slightly surreal atmosphere makes Last Call a unique destination where hidden moments bold drinks and elevated bites meet. Hours vary by season with the venue closed Sundays and Mondays.

title: Louie's Wine Dive and Kitchen 119
venue_description:
Louie's Wine Dive and Kitchen 119 - Award-Winning Wine Bar and Restaurant

Louie's Wine Dive and Kitchen 119 is an award-winning restaurant and wine bar located at 6701 W 119th Street in Overland Park Kansas. The venue celebrates great wine locally sourced and sustainable cuisine and the joy of shared moments with friends and family. Part of a small chain with locations in Clayton Missouri and Des Moines Iowa Louie's has become a premier destination for food and wine lovers in the Kansas City area.

Wine Program and Cocktails

Louie's Wine Dive features an extensive carefully curated selection of wines for both new wine drinkers and wine veterans. Many bottles are procured through personal relationships with small undiscovered vineyards around the world offering unique flavors and tremendous value. The featured wine board changes regularly showcasing new discoveries. In addition to wine the venue offers craft cocktails and a selection of local beers.

Culinary Excellence

The award-winning culinary program features well-trained and traveled Executive Chefs who prepare made-from-scratch menus daily. The restaurant uses locally sourced ingredients whenever possible and offers both traditional food favorites and chef-driven creative fare. The casual elegant atmosphere and reasonable price points make fine dining accessible to all guests. Weekend brunch is served Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM featuring beignets creative flatbreads and mimosa options.

Music and Atmosphere

Live music performances feature singer-songwriters and acoustic artists adding to the inviting atmosphere. The warm casually elegant setting with attentive service creates an ideal environment for celebrations dates and special gatherings. The entrance features a unique design with the live music area near the hostess stand. Friendly professional staff and attention to detail throughout the dining experience make Louie's Wine Dive a must-visit destination in Overland Park.
